category_title: Five-year-old students exhibiting school-related frustration and challenging peer interactions
scenario_title: Morning arrival and transition into classroom activities
minimal_context: Patrick is arriving at the classroom in the morning and needs to transition into a classroom activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Good morning. It is time to come into the classroom and pick an activity to do while the other children are working.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: School is dumb. I want to go home.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am sure we can find something you might like to do here.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am upset I could not bring my Power Rangers to school.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have interesting materials in the classroom you can interact with instead.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Kicks the furniture in frustration) No! I want to go home!
